tools.name: search_news_events
tools.description: Find news stories GlobeNow is tracking now or in the last few days, grouped from videos by many outlets. Returns each story's event_id, short summary, countries reporting it, number of outlets and videos, and links to the story page and the 3D globe. Leave query empty to list the top stories right n

tools.name: compare_event_coverage
tools.description: For one story (event_id from search_news_events), show how it is being reported in each country: number of videos, which outlets, languages, when coverage started, and the latest videos with original and translated titles, coordinates and YouTube links.

tools.name: get_city_news
tools.description: Latest news videos filmed or reported in a city (default: last 24 hours), with outlets, coordinates, YouTube links, related stories and links to the city page and the 3D globe.

tools.name: find_live_tv
tools.description: Free, official 24/7 live TV channels that broadcasters stream on YouTube (news, business, kids, music, religious and more), with country, language, whether the stream plays worldwide, current viewers and links. Clients that support MCP Apps can play the stream inline or in picture-in-picture.
